QuestInfo.name: Looking for the Red Cape
QuestInfo.1: #p218# also asked me to retrieve the #b#t4031064##k that #p201# in #m10001000# borrowed, to give it to her friend too. She'll give me something nice if I bring it back to her.
QuestInfo.2: I went to #p201# to get #p218#'s cape, but #p201# told me that she's keeping the cape until #p218# brings back what she borrowed from her.

0.0: Thanks to you, I think I was able to finally prepare a gift for my friend. But... somehow, it still feels like something's missing.
0.1: Right! I also need a cape for my friend! A few days ago, I lent a #b#t4031064##k to #p201# in #m10001000#, and I'd like you to get it back for me. I'm sure my friend will need it. How about it, will you help me?

yes.0: Please! If you can gather everything for me, I'll be able to make something to help my friend on their journey!

no.0: You must be very busy... If you have time later, please get back to me! My friend will set out soon...

1.0: Hi. Nice weather, isn't it? What? You want the #b#t4031064##k that I borrowed from #p218#?
1.1: Hmm... I should say... "No"... because I didn't borrow it from #p218#. #p218# took some things that were precious to me and never gave them back. So I took this cape from her in return. Therefore, no. I can't give this cape to you.

npc.0: You can get the #t4031064# from #p201# in #m10001000#...
